name: Forsaken: My Love and Hate For You
source:
Following Faust and Amon, you play through the hardships in they face in their early lives and come to learn how the relationship between the two unravels.

[From [url=https://graphicdreamer.itch.io/forsaken-my-love-and-hate-for-you]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟随浮士德和阿蒙，你将经历他们早年生活中所面临的困难，并了解两人之间的关系是如何破裂的。

[来自[url=https://graphicdreamer.itch.io/forsaken-my-love-and-hate-for-you]Itch.io[/url]]
